mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% annualized rate signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 3% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 6%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing housing starts (HOUST) and rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals broadening demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with both HOUST and RSAFS increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A crossing above 2% by the 10-year Treasury yield (not directly observable, using FEDFUNDS as proxy) signals a shift towards monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS above 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 7%) and increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a labor market at full capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected inflation pressures.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 55% of instances with UNRATE < 7% and PAYEMS above its 6-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are expected due to the general growth trend in GDP (GDPC1) as a baseline demand indicator.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
